feed.title: Regulation · Crypto · Diting Lab
feed.subtitle: Research papers and global crypto regulation, at a glance
feed.rights: Explanations and summaries are generated by AI from the original text. Dates, rates and amounts are checked against the source, but errors are still possible, so always rely on the original. Nothing here is legal, tax or investment advice.

entry.title: CFTC to hold a December 15 roundtable on 24/7 trading in derivatives markets
entry.summary: CFTC to Host Roundtable on 24/7 Trading CFTC · Oct 28, 2026 · Crypto The U.S. Commodity Futures Trading Commission announced an industry roundtable on December 15 to discuss whether derivatives markets can viably move to 24/7 trading. It builds on the CFTC's earlier summer Request for Comment on the topic. Discussion topics include overnight trading, tokenization, infrastructure, staffing, and operational readiness. The event will be held at CFTC headquarters in Washington and livestreamed on CFTC.gov.

entry.title: SFC issues guidance on enhancing Hong Kong's retail fund regime ahead of revised UT Code taking effect 1 November 2026
entry.summary: SFC issues guidance to support enhancements to Hong Kong’s retail fund regime SFC · Oct 28, 2026 · Crypto The Securities and Futures Commission of Hong Kong published guidance to help the fund industry prepare for the revised Code on Unit Trusts and Mutual Funds, which takes effect on 1 November 2026. Key changes include a Value-at-Risk approach to managing funds' derivatives exposure, enhanced liquidity risk management, and stronger investment and disclosure requirements for money market funds. The SFC also published revised key facts statement templates for different fund types to improve transparency.

entry.title: SFC and AFRC sign new MoU extending financial reporting oversight to licensed firms and funds
entry.summary: SFC and AFRC extend regulatory cooperation to financial reporting of licensed firms and funds under new MoU SFC · Sep 28, 2026 · Crypto The Securities and Futures Commission and the Accounting and Financial Reporting Council signed a new Memorandum of Understanding expanding their cooperation beyond listed entities. It covers financial and compliance reporting by licensed corporations, licensed virtual asset service providers, SFC-authorised funds and registered open-ended fund companies, along with related audit and assurance work. The MoU also sets out a framework for information sharing, case referrals, mutual assistance and coordinated inspections, and supersedes the 2021 MoU.

entry.title: SFC approves first-ever secondary trading of tokenised public funds
entry.summary: SFC approves first-ever secondary trading of tokenised public funds SFC · Oct 26, 2026 · Crypto The Hong Kong Securities and Futures Commission has approved the world's first secondary trading of tokenised public funds on an SFC-licensed virtual asset trading platform. Two existing SFC-authorised tokenised money market funds can now be traded around the clock. The SFC introduced a framework in April 2026 setting requirements for trading channel operation, fair pricing, liquidity provision and disclosure.

entry.title: ADGM Publishes Guidance on Crypto Mining Activities
entry.summary: ADGM Becomes the Region's First International Financial Centre to Publish Dedicated Crypto Mining Guidance ADGM / FSRA · Oct 28, 2026 · Crypto The Registration Authority of ADGM has published guidance on crypto mining activities within or from the centre. Issued under the Commercial Licensing Regulations 2025, it treats crypto mining as a licensable commercial activity rather than a regulated financial service. The technology-neutral guidance covers Proof-of-Work, Proof-of-Stake and future consensus mechanisms. It is the first phase of the authority's approach, with a regulatory framework to be developed and consulted on later.

entry.title: NCUA Seeks Public Comment on Draft 2027–2028 Budget
entry.summary: NCUA Draft 2027-2028 Budget Federal Register · Oct 28, 2026 · Crypto The National Credit Union Administration published its draft detailed business-type budget for fiscal years 2027 and 2028 for public review, as required by federal statute. The draft covers three components: the Operating Budget, the Capital Budget, and the Share Insurance Fund Administrative Budget. Public comments may be submitted through regulations.gov under docket NCUA–2026–2146 by November 30, 2026, and in-person statements may be presented at a November 17, 2026 budget hearing.

entry.title: VARA Circular on Good Practice for VASP Public Disclosures
entry.summary: Circular: Good practices for VASP’s public disclosures VARA · Oct 28, 2026 · Crypto VARA issued a circular describing good-practice characteristics for public disclosures by licensed Virtual Asset Service Providers, based on its thematic review. It states that disclosure compliance should be an ongoing obligation requiring governance, monitoring and periodic testing rather than a one-time licensing task. The circular is illustrative only and does not modify any Regulations or Rulebooks.

entry.title: FSA posts agenda for third meeting of Business Accounting Council's sustainability assurance subcommittee on third-party assurance standards
entry.summary: 企業会計審議会第３回サステナビリティ情報保証部会の議事次第について公表しました。 金融庁 · Oct 28, 2026 · Crypto The Financial Services Agency published the agenda and materials for the third meeting of the Business Accounting Council's Sustainability Information Assurance Subcommittee, scheduled for October 29, 2026. The secretariat's briefing material is a draft opinion on standards for assurance services, quality management, and ethics and independence for sustainability information. It explains the background, the purpose of third-party assurance, and the proposed nature and names of the standards.

entry.title: FSA recruits a lawyer for monitoring of crypto and fund transfer business compliance
entry.summary: 採用,職員を募集しています。（金融モニタリング業務（資金移動業者や暗号資産交換業者等の法令等遵守態勢、関連法令の解釈等）に従事する職員) 金融庁 · Oct 28, 2026 · Crypto The Financial Services Agency announced on October 28, 2026 a recruitment for one lawyer as a fixed-term national civil servant. The role covers monitoring legal compliance of crypto asset exchange and fund transfer businesses, legal interpretation, and developing guidelines. Employment is expected from around January 2027 for about two years, selected by document screening and interview.

entry.title: CFTC and Kansas State University co-host AgCon 2026 agricultural futures conference in Kansas
entry.summary: ICYMI: Agricultural Leaders and Market Participants Join CFTC Chairman Selig in Overland Park, Kansas for AgCon 2026 CFTC · Oct 27, 2026 · Crypto The CFTC and Kansas State University's Risk Management Center co-hosted the two-day 2026 Agricultural Commodity Futures Conference (AgCon) in Overland Park, Kansas. Panels covered the agricultural economy, derivatives market developments, farm credit, and risk management tools for producers. Topics included perpetual futures, 24/7 trading, and tokenized collateral. CFTC Chairman Michael S. Selig attended and delivered the closing remarks.

entry.title: SEC Sues TSAI Pro Ltd. and TSAI Capital Foundation Over Fake AI Trading Bot Scheme
entry.summary: SEC Charges Multiple Entities in Fraud Schemes Totaling at Least $15 Million That Used WhatsApp and Other Platforms to Lure Investors SEC · Sep 29, 2026 · Crypto The SEC filed a complaint against TSAI Pro Ltd. and TSAI Capital Foundation, alleging they promoted an AI trading bot program promising guaranteed profits via their website, WhatsApp groups and Facebook. The complaint says no AI trading bots existed and deposited funds were never used to generate returns for investors. The defendants also falsely claimed SEC regulation and displayed a phony SEC certificate and falsified Form D.

entry.title: Fee schedule amendment updating the definition of “trading platform” (Cboe EDGX, SR-CboeEDGX-2026-072)
entry.summary: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Cboe EDGX Exchange, Inc.; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change To Amend Its Fee Schedule To Update the Definition of Trading Platform Federal Register · Oct 26, 2026 · Crypto The SEC published a notice of a proposed rule change filed by Cboe EDGX Exchange to amend its fee schedule and update the definition of “trading platform.” The filing was made on October 19, 2026, and is effective upon filing under Rule 19b-4(f)(2). The notice invites public comments, to be submitted on or before November 16, 2026.

entry.title: Federal Reserve proposes application procedures for bank subsidiaries seeking approval to issue payment stablecoins
entry.summary: Application Procedures for Board-Supervised Insured Depository Institutions Seeking Approval for a Subsidiary To Issue Payment Stablecoins Federal Register · Sep 29, 2026 · Crypto The Federal Reserve Board proposes rules under the GENIUS Act establishing procedures for insured state member banks to seek Board approval for a subsidiary to issue payment stablecoins. The proposal would be added as Subpart D to Regulation UU in 12 CFR part 247 and defines "payment stablecoin" consistent with the Act. Comments are due November 30, 2026.

entry.title: Proposed rule barring fund transfers involving A7 network sub-agents
entry.summary: Proposal of Special Measure Prohibiting the Transmittal of Funds Regarding Transactions Involving the A7 Network's Sub-Agents Federal Register · Oct 5, 2026 · Crypto The Financial Crimes Enforcement Network (FinCEN) of the U.S. Treasury proposes a special measure prohibiting the transmittal of funds in transactions involving the A7 network's sub-agents. The excerpt provided ends at the opening of the summary.

entry.title: US Stablecoin Rules: OCC Regulations for Stablecoin Issuance by Supervised Entities
entry.summary: Implementing the Guiding and Establishing National Innovation for U.S. Stablecoins Act for the Issuance of Stablecoins by Entities Subject to the Jurisdiction of the Office of the Comptroller of the Currency Federal Register · Oct 23, 2026 · Crypto The Office of the Comptroller of the Currency issued a final rule implementing the GENIUS Act for payment stablecoin issuance and related activities by entities under its jurisdiction. The rule takes effect January 18, 2027, and addresses about 328 comments received on the March 2026 proposal.

entry.title: UK regulator secures repayment for crypto fraud victims
entry.summary: FCA secures money back for victims of crypto fraud FCA · Sep 28, 2026 · Crypto The FCA obtained confiscation orders against Raymondip Bedi and Patrick Mavanga, who ran a fake cryptoasset investment scheme that defrauded at least 65 investors of £1,541,799. On 28 September 2026, Bedi was ordered to pay £603,404.28 and Mavanga £247,997.99. The FCA says funds recovered through the process will be returned to victims.

entry.title: FSA announces support decision for a proof-of-concept under its FinTech PoC Hub and Payment Innovation Project (PIP)
entry.summary: 「FinTech実証実験ハブ・決済高度化プロジェクト（PIP）」支援決定案件の公表 金融庁 · Sep 29, 2026 · Crypto On September 29, 2026, the Financial Services Agency (FSA) announced it has decided to support a proof-of-concept project under the PIP, the fourth such case in that program. The experiment tests practical use of stablecoins in funds settlement for trade transactions and sorts out related legal issues, running from September 2026 for the time being. After completion, the FSA plans to publish the results and conclusions on its website.

entry.title: ESMA Sets 2027 Priorities to Strengthen, Simplify and Integrate EU Capital Markets
entry.summary: ESMA sets 2027 priorities for stronger, simpler and more integrated EU capital markets ESMA · Sep 28, 2026 · Crypto The European Securities and Markets Authority (ESMA), the EU financial markets regulator, published its 2027 Annual Work Programme on 28 September 2026. Guided by its 2023–2028 strategy, the programme shifts several major initiatives from preparation to delivery. Key areas include simplifying regulatory and reporting frameworks, expanding supervisory mandates such as for ESG rating providers, and greater use of data and technology in supervision.

entry.title: Federal Reserve proposal to implement its GENIUS Act duties for stablecoin issuers
entry.summary: Implementing the Federal Reserve Board's Responsibilities Under the GENIUS Act Federal Register · Sep 29, 2026 · Crypto The Federal Reserve Board proposes rules to implement the GENIUS Act for permitted payment stablecoin issuers it supervises and certain other entities under its jurisdiction. It also proposes rules implementing the Act's tying prohibition, which applies to all permitted payment stablecoin issuers. The proposal covers topics such as reserve assets, redemption, risk management, capital, and custodians. Comments are due by November 30, 2026.

entry.title: HKSAR Government's fourth digital green bond offering
entry.summary: HKSAR Government’s Fourth Digital Green Bonds Offering HKMA · Sep 29, 2026 · Crypto The Hong Kong SAR Government priced about HK$20 billion of digital green bonds in HKD, RMB, USD and EUR under its Government Sustainable Bond Programme. Subscription ratios across the four currencies ranged from 1.3 to 11.3 times. The HKD tranche settled using tokenised deposits, and the issuance adopted the ICMA Bond Data Taxonomy version 2.01.

entry.title: HKMA and Bank Negara Malaysia Strengthen Bilateral Cooperation
entry.summary: Hong Kong Monetary Authority and Bank Negara Malaysia Strengthen Bilateral Cooperation HKMA · Oct 6, 2026 · Crypto The HKMA and Bank Negara Malaysia held a high-level bilateral meeting in Hong Kong on 2 October, exchanging views on macroeconomic and financial developments, banking regulation, fintech, and capital market connectivity. The two institutions agreed to strengthen collaboration on fintech and digital assets, cross-border regulation, local currency usage and infrastructure linkages, and capital market connectivity.

entry.title: FCA opens applications for regulated crypto firms in the UK
entry.summary: FCA opens the gateway to regulated crypto FCA · Sep 30, 2026 · Crypto From today, crypto firms can apply to the Financial Conduct Authority (FCA) for authorisation. Crypto firms operating in the UK will be brought under full FCA regulation, with standards covering consumer protection, safeguarding, market integrity and financial resilience. Firms intending to keep operating must apply by 28 February 2027, and the new regime comes into force on 25 October 2027.

entry.title: Agenda for the First Meeting of the AI-Era On-Chain Finance Forum
entry.summary: 「AI時代を見据えたオンチェーン金融フォーラム」（第１回）議事次第 金融庁 · Sep 30, 2026 · Crypto This is the agenda for the first meeting of Japan's Financial Services Agency (FSA) "On-Chain Finance Forum for the AI Era," held on September 30, 2026. It lists the opening, reports from relevant ministries, discussion, and closing, and attaches the member roster and an FSA briefing document. The briefing describes promoting blockchain-based "on-chain finance" alongside existing off-chain financial infrastructure, with an interim summary planned for early 2027.

entry.title: Financial Services Agency personnel changes (senior staff list updated as of September 30, 2026)
entry.summary: 人事異動（令和８年９月30日付幹部名簿の更新） 金融庁 · Oct 2, 2026 · Crypto This Financial Services Agency notice reports personnel changes and attaches the FSA senior staff directory as of September 30, Reiwa 8 (2026). It lists titles and names for the minister, vice minister, parliamentary officials, and staff at the FSA, the Securities and Exchange Surveillance Commission, and the Certified Public Accountants and Auditing Oversight Board. The text consists mainly of appointment dates and position lists and contains no policy content or conclusions.

entry.title: ESMA recommends changes to make MiCA clearer, safer and ready for emerging crypto services
entry.summary: ESMA calls for changes to make MiCA clearer, safer and ready for emerging services ESMA · Sep 30, 2026 · Crypto The European Securities and Markets Authority (ESMA) has responded to the European Commission's public consultation on reviewing the Markets in Crypto-Assets Regulation (MiCA). Its recommendations cover stronger investor protection, such as stricter marketing rules and cost transparency for staking, lending and borrowing, enhanced supervisory powers, clearer rules for decentralised finance and token classification, and simplification of the framework, alongside a pathway toward tokenised capital markets.

entry.title: SEC Proposes Rules on How Investment Advisers and Funds May Custody Crypto Assets
entry.summary: SEC Proposal Would Address How Investment Advisers and Funds Can Custody Crypto Assets Under the Federal Securities Laws SEC · Oct 2, 2026 · Crypto The U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission proposed new rules and amendments providing a tailored framework for registered investment advisers and regulated funds to custody crypto assets. The proposal would permit self-custody of crypto assets under certain conditions and allow state trust companies to serve as custodians. The public comment period will remain open for 60 days after publication in the Federal Register.

entry.title: Texas Stock Exchange proposes listing fees and market maker performance standards with daily stipends
entry.summary: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Texas Stock Exchange LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change To Adopt Listing Fees for Exchange Traded Products and Performance Standards and Daily Stipends Paid by the Exchange for Its Lead Market Maker Program Federal Register · Oct 1, 2026 · Crypto Texas Stock Exchange LLC filed a rule change with the SEC to adopt three fee tiers for exchange-traded products listed on the exchange. It also proposes three tiers of minimum performance standards for its Lead Market Maker program, with the exchange paying daily stipends to market makers that meet them. The filing says newer ETP categories are harder and costlier to make markets in, which motivates the proposal.

entry.title: Treasury interim final rule setting forms and procedures for the Stablecoin Certification Review Committee's review of state stablecoin certifications
entry.summary: Forms and Procedures for Review of State Certifications by the Stablecoin Certification Review Committee Federal Register · Sep 30, 2026 · Crypto The Treasury Department, on behalf of the Stablecoin Certification Review Committee, issued this interim final rule establishing procedural regulations and forms for the Committee to approve or deny state payment stablecoin regulators' certifications under section 4(c) of the GENIUS Act. The rule is effective September 30, 2026, but certifications will not be accepted until the information collection receives Paperwork Reduction Act approval. Comments are due by November 30, 2026.

entry.title: CFTC Secures Court Orders for Former Long Island Resident and Firm to Pay Over $288 Million in Commodity Pool Ponzi Scheme
entry.summary: CFTC Secures Federal Court Orders Requiring Former Long Island Resident and His Firm to Pay Over $288 Million for Operating a Commodity Pool Ponzi Scheme CFTC · Oct 19, 2026 · Crypto The CFTC announced that a federal court in the Southern District of New York ordered Eddy Alexandre and his company EminiFX Inc. to pay over $288 million, including $228,576,962 in restitution to defrauded investors, $15,049,500 in disgorgement of unlawful gains, and a $45,148,500 civil penalty. The order states EminiFX posed as an investment club promising weekly returns of 5% to 9.99% and was a Ponzi scheme. As of July 2026, over $98 million had been returned to more than 28,000 investors.

entry.title: UK capital market reform to serve the economy better (FCA speech)
entry.summary: Reforming UK capital markets to ensure they work well for our economy FCA · Oct 5, 2026 · Crypto Jon Relleen, FCA director of infrastructure and exchanges, delivered this speech at a 5 October 2026 summit on reforming UK capital market rules. He says the FCA has completed major parts of a multi-year programme aimed at supporting growth while preserving trust, market integrity and high standards. The speech cites delivered changes such as the revamped listing regime, the new public offers framework and improved bond and derivatives transparency.

entry.title: Minutes of the 57th Financial System Council General Meeting and 45th Financial Subcommittee Joint Meeting
entry.summary: 第57回金融審議会総会・第45回金融分科会合同会合議事録 金融庁 · Oct 5, 2026 · Crypto Minutes of the joint meeting held on August 31, 2026, published by the Financial Services Agency. Financial Minister Satsuki Katayama referred two questions to the Financial System Council: how to supply funds to growth companies, including flexible regulation of business lending, and the structure of insurance systems, including creating a reinsurance captive scheme and life insurance safety-net arrangements. Secretariat staff explained each item.

entry.title: Notice on the Cross-Industry Financial Cybersecurity Exercise (Delta Wall 2026)
entry.summary: 「金融業界横断的なサイバーセキュリティ演習 （Delta Wall 2026）」の実施の公表 金融庁 · Oct 5, 2026 · Crypto The Financial Services Agency will hold the 11th cross-industry cybersecurity exercise, Delta Wall 2026, from October 6 to 22, 2026, with 181 financial institutions expected to take part. The exercise aims to strengthen cyber resilience and incident response across the financial sector, including response readiness when core systems are attacked. Results will be shared with the wider industry beyond the participating institutions.

entry.title: Minutes of 1st Meeting of FSA Working Group on Growth Enterprise Financing Published
entry.summary: 金融審議会「成長企業への資金供給の在り方等に関するワーキング・グループ」（第１回）議事録の公表 金融庁 · Oct 7, 2026 · Crypto The Financial Services Agency published the minutes of the first meeting of the Financial System Council's Working Group on Financing for Growth Enterprises, held on September 16, 2026. The meeting covered diversifying funding providers and restructuring money lending regulations for business loans. The Japanese Bankers Association and the Institute of International Bankers also presented.

entry.title: Public notice of names of unregistered crypto-asset exchange operators
entry.summary: 無登録で暗号資産交換業を行う者の名称等の公表 金融庁 · Oct 7, 2026 · Crypto Japan's Financial Services Agency published a list of domestic and overseas operators that conducted crypto-asset exchange business without registration and were issued warning letters, including their names, locations, business details and posting dates. The list reflects status at the time of the warning and may not show current operations or addresses, and unlisted operators may also be unregistered. Users are advised to confirm that an exchange is registered with the FSA or a Local Finance Bureau before using it.

entry.title: ESMA sets supervisory expectations for services linked to non-MiCA-compliant stablecoins
entry.summary: ESMA sets out supervisory expectations on services related to unauthorised stablecoins ESMA · Oct 8, 2026 · Crypto The European Securities and Markets Authority (ESMA) has issued an opinion clarifying its supervisory expectations for crypto-asset services involving asset-referenced tokens and e-money tokens, known as stablecoins, that do not comply with MiCA. It states that MiCA-authorised crypto-asset service providers should stop providing such services to EU clients. National competent authorities should require remediation of any remaining exposures no later than three months after publication.

entry.title: ESMA seeks evidence on using tokenised collateral in central clearing
entry.summary: ESMA seeks evidence on the use of tokenised collateral in central clearing ESMA · Oct 9, 2026 · Crypto The European Securities and Markets Authority (ESMA) has launched a Call for Evidence on whether EU central counterparties (CCPs) could safely use tokenised collateral, with responses due by 15 January 2027. The paper examines how tokenisation may affect the transfer, management, protection and use of collateral across its lifecycle, including after a clearing member default. ESMA will assess the feedback in the first quarter of 2027.

entry.title: ADGM FSRA Seeks Industry Feedback on Proposed DeFi Risk Management Guidance
entry.summary: ADGM FSRA Invites Industry Feedback on Proposed DeFi Risk Management Guidance ADGM / FSRA · Oct 6, 2026 · Crypto The ADGM Financial Services Regulatory Authority (FSRA) has published a consultation paper seeking feedback on proposed guidance for managing risks from decentralised finance (DeFi) engagement. The guidance sets out expectations for how authorised persons and recognised bodies should identify, assess, monitor and manage DeFi-related risks. It covers governance, due diligence, financial crime controls, incident escalation, and client asset safeguards. Comments are due by 30 November 2026 and may be sent to fsra.consultation@adgm.com.

entry.title: CFTC Seeks Comment on Proposed Rules for Crypto Asset Transactions and Markets
entry.summary: CFTC Seeks Public Comment on Advanced Notice of Proposed Rulemaking Relating to Regulation Crypto Asset Transactions and Regulation Crypto Asset Markets CFTC · Oct 6, 2026 · Crypto The U.S. Commodity Futures Trading Commission published an Advanced Notice of Proposed Rulemaking signaling its intent to build a comprehensive framework for retail crypto asset commodity transactions (CTXs) under section 2(c)(2)(D) of the Commodity Exchange Act. The notice seeks comment on preventing abusive practices, sharing industry best practices, and codifying a designated contract market subcategory called a crypto asset market. Written comments are due within 60 days of Federal Register publication.

entry.title: Strong compliance functions help keep corporate finance markets trusted
entry.summary: Strong compliance functions support trusted corporate finance markets FCA · Oct 8, 2026 · Crypto The UK FCA reports findings from a survey of 411 corporate finance firms on their compliance functions, receiving 382 responses. Most firms carry out key compliance activities, but gaps remain in areas such as whistleblowing arrangements, breach registers and performance assessment. The FCA asks firms to reflect on their arrangements and says it will engage further with selected firms.

entry.title: Economic Secretary's UK Digital Assets Week speech on digitising financial markets
entry.summary: Economic Secretary to the Treasury speech for UK Digital Assets Week HMRC / gov.uk · Oct 6, 2026 · Crypto The Economic Secretary to the Treasury gave a speech at UK Digital Assets Week setting out the government's ambition to lead globally in digital assets. The speech cites the Wholesale Financial Markets Digital Strategy, the appointment of a Wholesale Digital Markets Champion, and approvals for HSBC and ClearToken to operate Digital Securities Depositories in the Digital Securities Sandbox. It also outlines a pilot issuance of the Digital Gilt Instrument (DIGIT) planned for the first quarter of 2027.

entry.title: Public comment request on MCC program reporting and NCUA proposed Call Report revisions
entry.summary: Proposed Agency Information Collection Activities; Comment Request Federal Register · Oct 9, 2026 · Crypto This notice seeks public comment on two proposed federal information collections. The first describes how the Millennium Challenge Corporation (MCC) gathers reporting and data to assess compact performance, publishing quarterly status summaries and Star Reports for completed compacts. The second proposes revising the National Credit Union Administration's Call Report (Form 5300) to collect data on credit unions' payment stablecoin activities, effective with the March 31, 2027 report date. Comments are due by December 8, 2026.

entry.title: Withdrawal of Proposed Special Measure on Crypto Mixing as a Money Laundering Concern
entry.summary: Proposal of Special Measure Regarding Convertible Virtual Currency Mixing, as a Class of Transactions of Primary Money Laundering Concern; Withdrawal Federal Register · Oct 6, 2026 · Crypto FinCEN is withdrawing its earlier finding and proposed rule under Section 311 of the USA PATRIOT Act. That proposal had treated international convertible virtual currency mixing as a class of transactions of primary money laundering concern and sought enhanced recordkeeping and reporting requirements. The original proposal was published at 88 FR 72701 on October 23, 2023, and the withdrawal takes effect October 6, 2026.

entry.title: Proposed rule withdrawal on reporting, recordkeeping and identity verification for certain convertible virtual currency or digital asset transactions
entry.summary: Requirements for Certain Transactions Involving Convertible Virtual Currency or Digital Assets; Withdrawal Federal Register · Oct 6, 2026 · Crypto FinCEN is withdrawing a 2020 proposed rule that would have required banks and money service businesses to report, keep records, and verify customer identities for transactions involving convertible virtual currency or digital assets held in unhosted wallets or wallets hosted in a FinCEN-identified jurisdiction. The agency states it will take no further action on this proposal.

entry.title: SEC Proposes Adviser and Regulated Fund Custody Rules and Crypto Custody Rules
entry.summary: Adviser and Regulated Fund Custody Rules; Crypto Custody Rules Federal Register · Oct 6, 2026 · Crypto The Securities and Exchange Commission proposes new custody rules for regulated investment companies to hold crypto securities and similar investments, and amendments for registered investment advisers to custody client crypto funds and securities. The proposal also modernizes existing custody rules and related reporting and recordkeeping requirements. Comments are due by December 7, 2026.

entry.title: Exchange rule change proposing listing and withdrawal standards for options on crypto-holding commodity trusts, and revised position and exercise limits for iShares Bitcoin Trust ETF options
entry.summary: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Investors Exchange LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of Proposed Rule Change To Establish Listing Standards and Withdrawal Criteria for Options on Commodity-Based Trusts Holding a Single Crypto Asset or Multiple Crypto Assets and To Amend Rules Regarding Position and Exercise Limits for Options on iShares Bitcoin Trust ETF Federal Register · Oct 7, 2026 · Crypto This is a Securities and Exchange Commission notice of a proposed rule change filed by Investors Exchange LLC (file number SR-IEX-2026-34), published October 7, 2026. According to the title, it would establish listing and withdrawal criteria for options on commodity-based trusts holding one or more crypto assets, and amend position and exercise limits for options on the iShares Bitcoin Trust ETF. The excerpt provided does not include the specific terms of these provisions.

entry.title: US Treasury Seeks Comment on Extending Digital Assets Criteria Form Collection
entry.summary: Agency Information Collection Activities; Proposed Collection; Comment Request; Information-Sharing Initiative: Digital Assets Criteria Form Federal Register · Oct 9, 2026 · Crypto The U.S. Treasury Department is requesting public comment on an extension without change of its Intake Form for Digital Assets Firms. The form collects information to verify whether applicants are eligible to receive Treasury's non-public cyber threat information. Written comments are due by December 8, 2026.

entry.title: Publication of Status of Responses to Unauthorized Remittance Issues for Deposits (as of End of March 2026)
entry.summary: 預貯金の不正送金問題等に対する対応状況（令和８年３月末）の公表 金融庁 · Oct 16, 2026 · Crypto The Financial Services Agency surveyed deposit-taking financial institutions on their status regarding authentication methods for ATMs and internet banking as of the end of March 2026, and published a summary of the results. The survey was voluntary and based on preliminary figures, which may be revised after verification.

entry.title: EU supervisors publish 2027 work priorities
entry.summary: European Supervisory Authorities set priorities for 2027 ESMA · Oct 13, 2026 · Crypto The Joint Committee of the EBA, EIOPA and ESMA published its 2027 Annual Work Programme, setting out priorities for cross-sectoral risks and coordination. Key areas include digital operational resilience (under DORA, including oversight of critical ICT third-party providers), technological innovation, sustainable finance, securitisation and risk monitoring. The programme also covers consumer protection and supports the EU's simplification agenda to reduce unnecessary regulatory burdens.

entry.title: ESMA's third sanctions report calls for more consistent enforcement across the EU
entry.summary: ESMA's third Sanctions Report highlights the need for greater convergence in enforcement ESMA · Oct 15, 2026 · Crypto The European Securities and Markets Authority (ESMA) has published its consolidated report on sanctions and measures imposed across the EEA in 2025. National authorities imposed more than 950 administrative sanctions and measures, with administrative fines totaling almost €82 million, and settlements were used more often. The report finds significant differences in enforcement and says ESMA will foster exchanges among national authorities so similar breaches lead to similar outcomes.

entry.title: ESMA updates transparency manual with guidance on OTC derivatives and tick-size regime
entry.summary: ESMA updates its manual on transparency with new guidance for OTC derivatives and tick-size regime ESMA · Oct 15, 2026 · Crypto The European Securities and Markets Authority (ESMA) has updated its manual on pre- and post-trade transparency under MiFID II/MiFIR. The update clarifies which over-the-counter derivatives are subject to transparency requirements, how their identifying reference data should be provided, and adds Q&As and recommendations on the tick-size regime. The updated manual is to be considered a draft until the related technical standards (RTS 2 and the RTS on CTP input/output data) enter into force.

entry.title: New Q&As published on crowdfunding, crypto-asset and clearing rules
entry.summary: New Q&As available ESMA · Oct 16, 2026 · Crypto ESMA has published new Q&As covering European crowdfunding service providers, the Markets in Crypto-Assets Regulation (MiCA), and the EMIR framework for OTC derivatives, central counterparties and trade repositories. Three CCP-related questions are listed: the AAR 85% exemption, AAR thresholds calculation, and the AAR representativeness obligation.

entry.title: 3iQ's UAE Unit Receives In-Principle Approval for ADGM Category 4 Licence
entry.summary: 3iQ Receives In-Principle Approval from Abu Dhabi’s IFC 12 Oct 2026 ADGM / FSRA · Oct 12, 2026 · Crypto 3iQ Middle East Ltd, a UAE-based subsidiary of 3iQ Corp., has received In-Principle Approval for a Category 4 licence from the Financial Services Authority (FSRA) of ADGM in Abu Dhabi. The announcement says this supports 3iQ's goal of being regulated in major digital asset hubs so accredited investors can access its investment offerings. The approval is an interim step in the licensing process.

entry.title: HKMA welcomes launch of Chongqing-Hong Kong cross-boundary data validation platform for secure data checks without moving original documents
entry.summary: HKMA welcomes launch of Chongqing-Hong Kong Cross-boundary Data Validation Platform HKMA · Oct 14, 2026 · Crypto On 14 October 2026, Chongqing and Hong Kong authorities launched the Chongqing-Hong Kong Cross-boundary Data Validation Platform (CQ-HK DVP), which uses blockchain technology and hash values to verify customer-submitted data without transferring or storing original documents across the border. The platform will initially support cross-boundary financial use cases, such as account opening and loan applications, building on the Shenzhen-Hong Kong platform.

entry.summary: IRS reminder: Year-round tax planning can make filing easier IRS · Oct 23, 2026 · Crypto The IRS encourages taxpayers to take simple steps now, such as checking withholding, organizing records, using IRS online tools, and protecting personal information, to prepare for the 2027 filing season. entry.title: Abu Dhabi delegation ends London visit, advancing investment partnerships with UK firms
entry.summary: Abu Dhabi delegation concludes visit to London, Advancing Investment Partnerships and expanding business opportunities with UK companies 20 Oct 2026 ADGM / FSRA · Oct 20, 2026 · Crypto ADIO, ADCCI and ADGM held high-level engagements in London from 13 to 15 October, including the third Abu Dhabi Investment Forum (ADIF). Abu Dhabi Customs also received an international award for its blockchain-based TradeChain platform.

entry.title: SEC Releases Fiscal Year 2027 Examination Priorities
entry.summary: SEC Announces Fiscal Year 2027 Examination Priorities SEC · Oct 23, 2026 · Crypto The SEC announced the Division of Examinations' priorities for fiscal year 2027. The report highlights areas such as investment adviser fiduciary duties, retail investor protection, private funds and private credit, broker-dealer obligations, cybersecurity, and emerging technologies. The priorities are not exhaustive, and the Division may adjust its focus during the year.

entry.title: Speech on deliberately reshaping regulation by the FCA's deputy chief executive
entry.summary: Reshaping regulation, deliberately FCA · Oct 21, 2026 · Crypto Sarah Pritchard, deputy chief executive of the UK Financial Conduct Authority, gave this speech at the Investment Association Annual Dinner on 20 October 2026. She says the FCA is past the peak of rule making but continues a strategic approach to reform. She encourages firms to engage and identify where friction lies.

entry.title: Market integrity in a digital age: FCA chief executive's City Dinner speech
entry.summary: Market integrity in a digital age FCA · Oct 22, 2026 · Crypto Nikhil Rathi, chief executive of the UK Financial Conduct Authority (FCA), delivered this speech at the City of London Corporation's annual City Dinner at Mansion House. He argues that fast technological change brings opportunities but also serious threats to market integrity, including market abuse and financial crime, and that the regulatory system responds too slowly. He says the FCA will make better use of technology and intelligence and use its powers more assertively, and stresses that stronger partnerships between regulators, industry and government are essential.

entry.title: UK FCA restricts six unregulated lenders over anti-money laundering control concerns
entry.summary: FCA restricts 6 firms following concerns over anti-money laundering controls FCA · Oct 23, 2026 · Crypto The FCA has placed voluntary restrictions on six Annex 1 firms, unregulated lenders, after raising concerns about their anti-money laundering policies, controls and procedures. The restrictions limit their ability to take on new customers or do new business with existing customers, including extending credit. The FCA is also assessing responses to an information request sent to around 900 registered Annex 1 firms.

entry.title: Self Assessment deadline in 100 days: filing your 2025–26 tax return
entry.summary: Self Assessment deadline incoming – 100 days to go HMRC / gov.uk · Oct 23, 2026 · Crypto HM Revenue and Customs (HMRC) urges Self Assessment customers to file their 2025 to 2026 tax return early, with the deadline set for 31 January 2027. Filing early on GOV.UK lets people learn how much tax they owe, budget in advance, get refunds sooner and avoid penalties. The notice also lists available guidance, support tools and warnings about HMRC impersonation scams.

entry.title: Cboe BZX proposes updating its fee schedule definition of Trading Platform
entry.summary: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Cboe BZX Exchange, Inc.; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change To Amend Its Fee Schedule To Update the Definition of Trading Platform Federal Register · Oct 26, 2026 · Crypto Cboe BZX Exchange filed a rule change with the SEC to amend the definition of "Trading Platform" in its fee schedule. The proposal adds a functional, use-based category covering any system through which orders of persons other than the operator are systematically executed electronically. Non-exhaustive examples include a broker crossing system not filed as an ATS, a systematic internalization system, and a decentralized blockchain-based or tokenized environment.

entry.title: Cboe BYX Exchange proposes updating its fee schedule definition of “Trading Platform” (immediately effective)
